title: damocles

pitch.rule: rows (pitch & $3F0) >> 4 to that plus 19; each row is planes 1 and 3

panelArt.source: pristine DAM1 file head, before live readouts

compass.storage: nine rows of three words; third word, second word, low byte of first word

palette.state: pinned first-world capture; mutable palette, not universal colours

location.source: 8 bytes at $81DC + 2*code; Body code $7AA8, space code $7922; on a Body, nonzero $7882 overrides code to $78
location.rule: set plane across box; clear plane under glyph ink

inventoryName.source: 16-byte name before head item record; long-offset name table pointer $4BD10
inventoryName.rule: set plane across box; clear plane under glyph ink

altitude.source: surface: rounded eye Y $7AB6 / 16 as 16.16; Floor $7AC4=10 forces overflow; space: nearest range $791C converted by $4DEEE; two whole and four fractional digits
altitude.rule: set plane across box; clear plane under glyph ink

speed.source: sign 11/12 from $797C; nine digits from $4DFEC: top nibble, then repeatedly mask to 28 bits and multiply by ten; changed-value cache $4DFF0
speed.rule: set plane across box; clear plane under glyph ink

cash.source: BCD $7C42..$7C47, first of twelve digits omitted
cash.rule: set plane across box; clear plane under glyph ink

position.source: unsigned words $7A1E/$7A22, each (value*$FA00)>>16 printed as three digits
position.rule: set plane across box; clear plane under glyph ink

centre2Text.source: category 2 document page name, one row of 8 characters
centre2Text.rule: set plane across box; clear plane under glyph ink

centre5Text.source: category 5 centre text, two rows of 10 characters
centre5Text.rule: set plane across box; clear plane under glyph ink

messageBar.source: text pointer $7B98; plane byte offset $7BA2 is 0 or 2
messageBar.rule: scroll eight pixels per VBL for 36 VBLs, copy to other screen on VBL 37

clock.source: absolute seconds $793C; HH-MM-SS, separators remain pristine artwork
clock.rule: changed digits only; inverted bytes written to both planes in both screens

list.rule: plane 3 clear iff aboard ($7A8E=0) and eye Y < $28FA
nonzero: plane 0 set, plane 1 clear; zero: plane 0 clear, plane 1 set
run=3: plane 1 clear; walk=2: plane 1 set

gauges.rule: one row towards value per VBL; increase clears plane bits, decrease sets them; inventory value has no clamp in this reader

definitions.paletteRule: colourA -> $7864 and $6FD42; colourB -> $7862 and $6FD2A; active colours XOR $7A52 ($4D288)

selection.rule: art = $66100 + word[$66100 + 2*category]; categories 2 and 6 stamp five rows at line 1 from art+$400+20*band; plane 0 = complement of strip word; planes 1..3 = strip word

reveal.rule: each VBL copy rows 161..191 to 160..190 in both buffers; count 64..33 inserts black at row 191; count 32 swaps colours; count 32..1 inserts consecutive new artwork rows

differences: Damocles palette sources are $7862/$7864, not MIII $6F12/$6F14
category 2/6 band plane 0 is complemented, not MIII constant $FFFF
Damocles centre category dispatch is not the MIII METIS/TAXICARD composition

gaps: centre: category-specific document, navigation, options and other content writers are identified but their complete compositions and all live-state parity are not established
fonts: the specialised grid coordinate glyph bank is not decoded
fields: grid, mode-specific navigation alternatives and gauge value semantics are not fully decoded
palette: emitted colour words describe the pinned first-world state; live palette changes must follow the recovered rules
